mapper.select: SELECT config_id, config_key, config_value, config_type, description, encrypted_yn, use_yn, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM cpf_config ORDER BY config_key
SELECT config_id, config_key, config_value, config_type, description, encrypted_yn, use_yn, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM cpf_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey}
SELECT config_id, config_key, config_value, config_type, description, encrypted_yn, use_yn, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM cpf_config WHERE config_id = #{configId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cpf_config ( config_key, config_value, config_type, description, encrypted_yn, use_yn, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{configKey}, #{configValue}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{configType}, ''), 'STRING'), #{description}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{encryptedYn}, ''), 'N'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{useYn}, ''), 'Y'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{requestUser}, ''), 'SYSTEM'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{requestUser}, ''), 'SYSTEM'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE cpf_config SET config_key = #{request.configKey}, config_value = #{request.configValue}, config_type = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{request.configType}, ''), 'STRING'), description = #{request.description}, encrypted_yn = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{request.encryptedYn}, ''), 'N'), use_yn = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{request.useYn}, ''), 'Y'), updated_by = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{request.requestUser}, ''), 'SYSTEM'), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE config_id = #{configId}
